title: 计数器
html: 0
js: var n=0,el=document.getElementById('n'),note=document.getElementById('note');function paint(){el.textContent=n;}function put(v){n=v;paint();butlerUI.setState({n:n});}butlerUI.onInit(function(d){var s=d&&d.state;n=(s&&typeof s.n==='number')?s.n:0;paint();});butlerUI.onPush(function(d){if(d&&d.error)note.textContent='存不下: '+d.error;});document.getElementById('inc').onclick=function(){put(n+1);};document.getElementById('dec').onclick=function(){put(n-1);};document.getElementById('zero').onclick=function(){put(0);};document.getElementById('say').onclick=function(){note.textContent='...';butlerUI.call('counter.say',{text:'现在是 '+n}).then(function(r){note.textContent=(r&&r.ok)?'念完了':('念不了: '+((r&&r.message)||'未知'));});};
